name: review-cycle
description: Automated multi-agent code review cycle. Spawns reviewers in parallel (plus Codex when available), applies fixes per CLAUDE.md policy, admits a commit only when a reviewer saw exactly what it records, and asks before a push you did not request.

enabled.title: Commit gate
enabled.description: Refuse a commit unless a reviewer saw what it records, and ask before a push you did not request. Only you can change this, here in /config.
